intro.title: Know What You Have, Where It Is and When to Reorder
paragraphs: Keeping stock records on paper or in spreadsheets works until it does not. Numbers fall out of date, items run out without warning, money gets tied up in slow-moving products and nobody is sure which count is correct. A stock management system fixes this by recording every item that comes in, moves or goes out, automatically and in real time.

Our inventory management software organises your products, customers, suppliers, purchase orders and sales orders in one place. It sends low stock alerts, suggests reorders, tracks batches and expiry dates, and gives you clear reports on stock value and movement. It runs in the cloud, so you can check stock from the shop floor, the warehouse or home, on any device, with nothing to install.

Every business counts stock differently, so we set up and customise the system around your products, units, locations and approval rules, and connect it to your billing, accounting, POS or online store. Need something larger? Explore our <csd>custom software development</csd> or <contact>talk to us about your inventory</contact>.

process.title: How Does an Inventory Management System Work?
process.subtitle: The system tracks every product from the moment it arrives from a supplier until it reaches your customer.

steps.title: Set up products and locations
steps.desc: Add products with units, variants, prices, barcodes and reorder levels, and define your shops, warehouses and bins. Existing data can be imported.

steps.title: Receive stock
steps.desc: Create purchase orders, then record goods received by scanning items, which updates stock levels and supplier records instantly.

steps.title: Track every movement
steps.desc: Sales, dispatches, returns, transfers between locations and adjustments are recorded as they happen, so stock is always accurate.

steps.title: Get alerts and reorder on time
steps.desc: When an item reaches its reorder level you are alerted, with suggested quantities based on sales, so you avoid both stockouts and overstock.

steps.title: Review reports and plan
steps.desc: Check stock value, ageing, fast and slow movers and profit, then plan purchases and targets with confidence.

tech.title: Inventory Methods, Tracking and Reports Supported
tech.subtitle: Built on proven inventory control practices, configured for the way your business works.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about stock and inventory management software.

items.a: Stock management software, also called an inventory management system, records every product you buy, store and sell. It shows real-time stock levels, alerts you when items run low, manages purchase and sales orders, and produces reports on stock value and movement.

items.q: How does an inventory management system work?
items.a: You add your products and locations, then every purchase, sale, transfer and return updates stock automatically, often by scanning a barcode. The system alerts you at reorder levels and turns all movements into reports for planning and accounting.

items.q: Is this inventory software suitable for a small business?
items.a: Yes. We set up a simple version for small businesses and shops with just the features you need, such as stock, sales, purchases and billing, and you can add more locations and features as you grow.

items.q: Can I use a barcode scanner with the software?
items.a: Yes. It works with standard USB and Bluetooth barcode scanners and with mobile phone cameras. You can also print barcode labels, and use RFID tags for high-volume or high-value stock.

items.q: Is it cloud-based? Can I check stock on my phone?
items.a: Yes. The software is cloud-based, so you can access it securely from any browser, and staff can use the Android or iOS app for counting, receiving and dispatch, even with limited connectivity.

items.q: Can I move my stock data from spreadsheets?
items.a: Yes. We import your products, opening stock, customers and suppliers from your existing spreadsheets or software, check the data and train your team, so you start with accurate numbers.
